FAUSTO COMMERCIAL PRESENTS

Lease retail space directly on SW 8th Street (Calle Ocho) in Flagami, with direct frontage and visibility to heavy passing traffic. The building is divided into two units: one occupied by an established tenant and one available now, a straightforward opportunity to start, relocate or expand a business on this corridor.

Flagami is among Miami's densest neighborhoods, with nearly 15,000 residents per square mile living within walking distance of established shops and restaurants. With Miami-Dade retail vacancy holding near 3%, street-front space on a major corridor like Calle Ocho remains in short supply.
